dataset.title: NOAA NEFSC public spring survey: cod/haddock, 2021-2025

configuration.temperature_note: Not recorded in the supplied run configuration; do not assume a value.

tool_call_counts.note: The two failed calls were malformed search_species calls in Q06:2 and Q06:3; each trial recovered with a successful call.

scientific_review_note: The trial answers have not received a comprehensive independent scientific review. Later feedback on one excerpt did not establish scientific approval or a trial pass.

targeted_feedback.scope: A shortened excerpt from one historical answer, not the complete answer or the trial suite.
targeted_feedback.question: whether the 2023 survey context directly explains the lower figures.

responses.detail: Highlighted the geographic pattern of sampling and patchy cod catches, and recommended consultation with survey and cod-population specialists.

responses.perspective: Developer familiar with the survey database
responses.detail: The supplied interaction presented the claim and review question; the response included an uncertain explanation for why the survey was shortened.
Indicated the question was outside the respondent's expertise and recommended cod-population specialists. It is not known whether this respondent overlaps with either message.

targeted_feedback.limitations: Informal feedback supplied by the participant; identities and quotations are not included. It did not assess the full answer or trial suite, verify the numerical results, establish causation, or provide scientific approval.

numerical_payload_review.scope: Requested numerical payloads in development and supplementary cases were compared with packaged independent_reference.json; supplementary values were also checked against the local public snapshot/reference. Confirmation answers were reviewed against the supplied reference.
limitations: The original public CSV archive was not independently reprocessed as part of this bundle review.
Numerical payload agreement does not validate scientific interpretation or establish record-level report reconciliation.
Floating-point display and rounding are tolerated when comparing reported values.

case_findings.finding: All three report the cod annual series and coverage with unspecified weight units.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q01:1 and Q01:3 attribute lower 2023 catch to reduced sampling without establishing cause.

case_findings.finding: All three report haddock annual values and zero unknown measurements among recorded catch rows.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q02:1 attributes results to reduced sampling without establishing causation; this case does not test an actually missing measurement.

case_findings.finding: All three use the requested inclusive stratum range; the 2025 scope has no catch records and null totals.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q03:1 incorrectly calls all years observed despite its 2025 no-record row. Answers also overstate what station records establish about effort.

case_findings.finding: All three resolve Gadus morhua to Atlantic cod and report the reference values.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q04:2 calls unspecified units dimensionless and attributes part of a catch change to sampling without establishing cause.

case_findings.finding: All three return the published cod identity and limit the search to this snapshot.
case_findings.observed_issue: Each offers an exact-name follow-up but none performs one; whether the question requires that call is ambiguous.

case_findings.finding: All three correctly distinguish no snapshot match from absence in the full survey.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q06:2 and Q06:3 first make malformed search calls, then recover successfully.

case_findings.finding: All three report the two species over a shared scope and distinguish complete measurements from matched effort.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q07:2 suggests shared strata make a per-area comparison more consistent; no area normalization was performed.

case_findings.finding: All three identify the names as aliases of one species and refuse to fabricate a comparison.
case_findings.observed_issue: No trial invokes the duplicate-species comparison tool; this demonstrates answer-level refusal, not runtime rejection.

case_findings.finding: All three report coverage and correctly state that station records are not valid-haul counts.
case_findings.observed_issue: This case has no year with zero station records and does not test that edge case.

case_findings.finding: All three report no selected station/catch records and null totals for stratum 99999.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q10:2 says stations with no cod rows would establish measured zero; absent catch rows remain unknown. Q10:3 overstates that no stations mean no opportunity for catch beyond this selected scope.
case_findings.slide_summary: One answer treats absent catch rows as measured zero.

case_findings.finding: All three refuse to invent live 2026 values.
case_findings.observed_issue: No tool is called; the shared data dictionary already supplies the snapshot boundary.

case_findings.finding: All three report the requested values and decline to infer population decline.
case_findings.observed_issue: Q12:3 incorrectly says weight and number are both lowest in 2023; 2025 weight is lower. It also makes an unsupported causal claim about station counts and catch.
case_findings.slide_summary: One answer misranks weight and implies unsupported causation.

case_findings.finding: All three retrieve the 2025 snapshot coverage and report the supplied report counts, 370 + 25 = 395.
case_findings.observed_issue: Equal aggregate counts do not establish which records are non-representative; two answers overstate record identity. The report facts are supplied in the question.
case_findings.slide_summary: Matching aggregate station counts do not establish row identity.

case_findings.finding: All three select the curated 2023 context card, report catch and coverage, cite its source, and reject a population-trend conclusion.
case_findings.observed_issue: All three also overstate causation or equate station-record change with effort; the card is curated, not live report retrieval.
case_findings.slide_summary: All three find the context card; all overstate causation or effort.

case_findings.finding: All three retrieve values matching the supplied reference and decline to invent a Table 3 catch reconciliation.
case_findings.observed_issue: Some answers infer that the snapshot includes the report's non-representative stations from equal aggregate counts; row identity is not established.
